status: internally proved factor-two EB lift for the SU(2)-covariant qutrit class, a Spin(5)-covariant ququart class, the j=3/2 dipole-quadrupole slice, and all-anisotropic Clifford-vector support; general noncovariant/all-dimension question remains open

claims.statement: Every unital, trace-preserving, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint SU(2)-covariant channel Phi:M_3->M_3 admitting a symmetric two-output CPTP broadcaster has one full-domain canonical EB comparator with I-Psi <= 2(I-Phi). An explicit comparator is the mixture (1-s)Psi_nem+s Psi_coh, where s=2(2 lambda_1-1)_+ and lambda_1 is the vector-sector transfer eigenvalue. The exact star spectrum bounds all positive dual frames and three exact dual tests verify this mixture.
assumptions: spin-1 defining SU(2) representation on C^3
claims.status: internally reconstructed exact representation-theoretic proof with explicit comparator; independent external review and novelty clearance open
claims.novelty_boundary: The proof is restricted to the SU(2)-covariant qutrit class. It is not the unrestricted factor-two conjecture or the bounded-Holevo implication.
claims.costs: Exact 27-dimensional star spectrum and positive-cone separation. The explicit common comparator is compiled with 18 algebraic icosahedral outcomes; extracting lambda_1 from a black-box physical channel has a separate tomography or estimation cost.
claims.falsifier: An error in the normalized-Choi star identity, the exact characteristic polynomial, the pure-spin EB support, the SU(2) twirl reduction for arbitrary positive Q, or the cone-separation step.
claims.next_gate: Attack nonsymmetric qutrits or covariant channels with multiplicity greater than one; there the invariant dual and star ground space are matrix-valued.

claims.statement: The marginal qutrit channel obtained by applying the universal symmetric qubit 2-to-4 cloner to Sym^2(C^2) and tracing two output qubits has transfer decomposition Phi=Pi_0+(3/4)Pi_1+(7/20)Pi_2. It is self-compatible and is factor-two dominated by the coherent-spin-1 EB channel Psi=Pi_0+(1/2)Pi_1+(1/10)Pi_2.
assumptions: full-domain 2-to-4 cloner followed by regrouping into two symmetric pairs
claims.status: exact finite symbolic reconstruction; source cloner construction is established prior work
claims.novelty_boundary: This is a structured qutrit example and class control, not a counterexample or unrestricted theorem.
claims.costs: Exact qutrit channel from a 3-dimensional symmetric input to two 3-dimensional outputs; explicit 27x27 Choi data can be generated by the script. The comparator is a covariant continuous POVM; finite support exists by moment preservation.
claims.falsifier: The exact symbolic superoperator or coherent-state moment eigenvalues differ from the displayed sector coefficients.
claims.next_gate: Use the star certificate to screen nearby SU(2)-covariant extensions before attempting higher-dimensional families.

claims.statement: For any irreducible spin-j representation and any SU(2)-invariant positive dual Q on the traceless operator sectors, the largest eigenvalue of the full star Hamiltonian equals the maximum dual score over symmetric compatible CPTP extensions with SU(2)-covariant, unital, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint marginal. A top star eigenstate, after group twirl and output-swap averaging, gives a Choi state with reference marginal I/d and equal maximally mixed output marginals; Bose-subspace support is not assumed. The canonical EB support is the maximum over pure seeds of sum_l alpha_l d^2 ||Pi_l(P-I/d)||_{2,tau}^2.
assumptions: spin-j irreducible representation on dimension d=2j+1
symmetric means output-swap invariant, not Bose-supported
claims.status: internally proved exact representation-theoretic reduction; no higher-spin factor-two inequality is proved
claims.novelty_boundary: Covariant-channel irreducible-sector structure is prior work. The exact compatible star-support equality and its canonical EB moment comparison are reconstructed here; no priority claim is made.
claims.costs: Finite representation and angular-momentum recoupling for fixed j; no arbitrary-j symbolic spectrum or efficient compiler has been produced.
claims.falsifier: Failure of the twirl/swap averaging to preserve top star expectation, Choi trace-preservation or output marginals, or the normalized-trace canonical EB support formula.
claims.next_gate: Prove or refute lambda_max(H_Q) <= Tr(Q)+S_j(Q) for all alpha_l>=0 at j>1; then test noncovariant channels separately.

claims.statement: For every d, the isotropic positive dual Q=I on the traceless Hilbert-Schmidt space satisfies lambda_max(H_Q)=d^2+d-2=Tr_HS(Q)+sup_canonical_EB Tr_HS(Q Psi). The exact star spectrum follows from the principal angle 1/d between the two maximally-entangled reference-output projection ranges; canonical EB support is d-1.
claims.status: internally proved exact analytic equality; not a general positive-Q theorem
claims.novelty_boundary: This is a standard maximally-entangled-projector monogamy calculation reconstructed as an all-frame normalization control; it does not establish novelty or a general factor-two theorem.
claims.costs: Closed-form finite-dimensional proof; no numerical or solver cost.
claims.falsifier: A failure of the maximally-entangled projector completeness identity, principal-angle calculation, or rank-one canonical EB trace computation.
claims.next_gate: Find an anisotropic positive Q that improves on or violates this exact threshold.

claims.statement: The explicit spin-1 coherent/nematic common canonical EB comparator has an exact implementation using twelve coherent rank-one effects and six antipodally aggregated nematic rank-one effects. Its normalized Choi matrix equals the orbit-integral comparator entrywise because the icosahedral direction set integrates all degree-at-most-four Choi moments exactly; its transfer eigenvalues are (1,s/2,2/5-3s/10) on ranks 0,1,2.
claims.status: internally verified exact symbolic construction; compiler outcome count is finite, prior design is standard, no external review
claims.novelty_boundary: The icosahedron 5-design and coherent/nematic orbits are established structures. The result is the exact 18-outcome implementation of this common comparator, not a new design or general EB compiler.
claims.costs: Twelve coherent plus six nematic outcomes in algebraic sqrt(5) coordinates; exact checker passes in about 1.5 seconds. Exact scalar lambda_1 is input. Physical estimation of lambda_1 is not included.
claims.falsifier: Failure of exact degree-five moment checks, projector identities, POVM normalization, normalized-Choi equality, or mixture characteristic polynomial.
claims.next_gate: Assess physical implementation and channel-parameter estimation costs if the compiler is used experimentally.

claims.statement: For irreducible Clifford spinor dimensions d=2,4,8,16,32 (m=3,5,7,9,11 anticommuting Hermitian generators), the vector dual Q=sum_i |Gamma_i><Gamma_i| has canonical EB support 1 and full ordinary-tensor-product star maximum lambda_max(H_Q)=m+1=Tr(Q)+S(Q). Exact annihilating polynomials and top multiplicities are given in CLIFFORD_VECTOR_DUAL.md. The top spectral projector is a Spin-invariant, output-swap-invariant Choi state with maximally mixed one-party marginals, hence a legal symmetric broadcaster.
assumptions: normalized trace tau=Tr/d and ordinary tensor product outputs
swap invariance, with no Bose-subspace assumption
claims.status: internally proved exact equality control by Pauli-word certificates; not an obstruction or all-dual theorem
claims.novelty_boundary: Universal cloning and Clifford algebra are standard. The finite exact star certificates are reconstructed here; no novelty, priority, or arbitrary-m claim is made.
claims.costs: Exact sparse Pauli-word algebra on three spinor factors; dimensions 8,64,512,4096,32768. Largest audited Pauli support is 524800. The m=11 bitmask certificate completes in about 45 seconds; no dense eigensolver, grid, or SDP.
claims.falsifier: An error in the normalized-Choi star identity, Clifford Pauli expansion, exact p(H)=0 certificate, projector multiplicity, group-invariant marginal constraints, or pure-seed EB support bound.
claims.next_gate: The arbitrary-anisotropy vector-sector bound is now derived for every odd m; extend to bivector/mixed Clifford-form duals and independently audit the odd-k chirality-block reduction.

claims.statement: For every odd m=2n+1>=3 irreducible complex Clifford spinor frame in dimension d=2^n and every positive dual Q supported on its m-dimensional vector span, the full ordinary-tensor-product two-output star satisfies lambda_max(H_Q) <= Tr_HS(Q)+lambda_max(Q). The exact canonical measure-and-prepare support is S_canEB(Q)=lambda_max(Q). The proof diagonalizes Q by Spin(m), proves the unweighted k-generator support bound k+1 on all parity/chirality blocks by a total-spin sum-of-squares, and applies a layer-cake decomposition to arbitrary nonnegative eigenweights.
assumptions: m=2n+1>=3 and an irreducible Hermitian Clifford frame on C^(2^n)
normalized trace tau=Tr/d and normalized Hilbert-Schmidt vector basis
positive Q supported only on the Clifford vector span
ordinary two-output tensor product; compatibility means output-swap invariant Choi extension, not Bose-subspace support
claims.status: internally proved exact SOS and anisotropic layer-cake inequality; independently hostile-audited with PROVED_WITH_SCOPE_CLARIFICATION, including both odd-subset central signs and exact physical m=5,k=3 check; external-priority review remains open
claims.novelty_boundary: The qubit c=2 corollary is already established in work/agents/quantum_physics/broadcast_lift/REPORT.md and is not a new result. Universal cloning, Clifford algebras, and broad monogamy are prior art; the bounded primary-source search did not establish novelty. This claim covers only positive duals in the Clifford vector sector, not arbitrary Q, other Clifford forms, a general common EB comparator, or bounded-Holevo broadcasting.
claims.costs: Closed-form algebraic proof independent of dimension after the spinor representation is supplied; exact SymPy identity checks use canonical spaces up to k=5. Physical acquisition of a channel or its vector-sector transfer data is not included.
claims.falsifier: A failure of the A_i,B_i shift-algebra decomposition including either odd-k central sign, the SOS identity H_(k,epsilon)^2/4=J^2+1/4-C C-dagger, the Choi star normalization, or the exact canonical-EB support formula.
claims.next_gate: Extend the comparison to anisotropic bivector/mixed Clifford-form duals beyond the Spin(5)-covariant ququart class; arbitrary all-Q common-comparator and bounded-Holevo questions remain open.

claims.statement: For spin j=3/2 and every invariant dual Q=a Pi_1+b Pi_2 with a,b>=0, the exact canonical-EB support is S(Q)=9a/5+b and the full swap-invariant compatible-extension star is h(Q)=max(r1,r2)<=24a/5+6b=Tr_HS(Q)+S(Q), where r1=(6a+2 sqrt(9a^2+125b^2))/5 and r2=(140a+200b+sqrt(2000(5a^2+4ab+5b^2)))/50. Moreover the one fixed spin-coherent EB channel with transfers (mu_1,mu_2)=(3/5,1/5) dominates 2Phi-I on ranks 0,1,2 for every covariant self-compatible marginal.
assumptions: SU(2)-covariant, unital, trace-preserving, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint marginal of a full-domain symmetric CPTP broadcaster
positive invariant dual Q supported only on ranks 1 and 2
output symmetry means swap-invariant Choi state, not Bose-subspace support
claims.status: internal exact Racah and pure-seed proof; independently reconstructed full 64-dimensional star spectra and mixed central polynomial; no external proof or priority review
claims.novelty_boundary: The universal cloner, SU(2) tensor-operator decomposition, and Racah recoupling are standard ingredients. This is a fixed-j, two-sector mixed-weight result and does not cover rank 3 at j=3/2, all mixed weights for j>=2, noncovariant maps, or the bounded-Holevo theorem. No priority claim is made.
claims.costs: Closed finite representation calculation: a 64x64 exact tripartite star, five total-spin blocks, and five pure rank-two tensor components; the independent SymPy checker completes in under one second. No channel-estimation or physical implementation cost is included.
claims.falsifier: An incorrect reference spin-flip phase, tensor-sector normalization, Racah block/spectrum, pure-seed quadrupole identity, swap-twirl feasibility, or common-comparator transfer bound.
claims.next_gate: Analyze rank 3 at j=3/2, then mixed multipole weights for j>=2 and general anisotropic non-SU(2) duals.

claims.statement: Every unital, trace-preserving, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint Spin(5)-covariant channel Phi:M4->M4 admitting a two-output CPTP broadcaster has one fixed canonical EB comparator Psi(X)=(X+Tr(X)I)/5 with Psi-(2Phi-id) positive as a Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint superoperator. The proof uses operator sectors 1+5+10, exact canonical-EB support S(a Pi_1+b Pi_2)=a+2b, and exact 64-dimensional star spectra with maxima 6 and 12; covariance twirling extends the support inequality to every positive dual Q.
assumptions: full-domain two-output CPTP extension with both marginals equal to Phi
order is Hilbert-Schmidt superoperator positivity, not complete positivity of the difference
claims.status: internally proved scoped common-comparator theorem; exact SymPy characteristic-polynomial and Fierz checks pass; independent external proof/priority review remains open
claims.novelty_boundary: Spin(5) representation theory, covariance/twirling, projective orbit averaging and measure-prepare channels are standard. The bounded primary-source search did not identify this exact mixed vector-bivector broadcaster-star/common-comparator statement; this is not a priority or novelty claim. The result does not cover noncovariant ququart maps, arbitrary higher dimensions, or bounded-Holevo broadcasting.
claims.costs: Exact matrices of dimension 64 over Q(i); the script checks Clifford relations, normalized-trace frame, a Fierz identity, and both full characteristic polynomials. No solver grid or SDP. A continuous orbit POVM is given; the explicit comparator is the dimension-four depolarizing EB channel.
claims.falsifier: An error in sector decomposition/normalization, the pure-state Fierz and Parseval moments, the exact star characteristic polynomials, normalized-Choi star identity, or transfer-sector comparison.
claims.next_gate: Extend to Spin(2n+1) spinors and all exterior-form sectors, or find an anisotropic noncovariant ququart dual separating every canonical EB map.

open_gates: No positive dual frame separating every EB map from 2 Phi-I has been constructed for a general noncovariant self-compatible channel.
No bounded-Holevo family with vanishing two-marginal error and nonvanishing optimal common EB error has been constructed.
The exact arbitrary-j compatible star support is known from twirl/swap symmetrization, but its comparison with canonical EB support remains open for j>1.
No noncovariant full-star dual inequality or obstruction has been proved.

The anisotropic Clifford-vector factor-two support inequality is internally proved for every odd m and independently hostile-audited; anisotropic bivector/mixed-form duals beyond the Spin(5)-covariant ququart class and arbitrary all-Q comparison remain open.
The j=3/2 mixed dipole-quadrupole slice is settled in MIXED_WEIGHT_GATE.md; rank-3 duals at j=3/2 and mixed multipoles for j>=2 remain open.
The Spin(5)-covariant ququart common comparator theorem is internally proved; external proof/priority review, noncovariant ququart maps, and higher Spin(2n+1) exterior-form sectors remain open.
